answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a shared atlas of bonded identities: each newcomer posts a non-refundable stake before its first attestation, indexed publicly so duplicates are visible. Trust then climbs a mesa of graded work—only established peers may countersign, and rubber-stamping empty shells costs them mining weight. A dense grove of original epoch essays seals entry: copy templates fail peer grades, so attacker spend scales with real writing and capital, not how many wallets they open.
